name: GhostCam v1.2.0
added: Cover latch: keeps covering your face for a moment after the detector loses it, so a blink or a head turn can't expose you for a frame
Background blur and replace: hide your room, not just your face — blur it, swap in your own image, or black it out
Profiles: three one-click presets (WORK CALL, STREAM, FULL ANON) that load all your cloak settings at once
Pipeline watchdog: if the camera stalls or gets unplugged while you're live, the output goes black instead of freezing on your last frame
START WITH WINDOWS toggle — GhostCam can launch straight to the tray at sign-in
Portable ZIP download for anyone whose antivirus blocks the installer
fixed: New layout built around a large live preview with a tabbed control rail, instead of stacked panels
Face tracking no longer jitters when the detector briefly misses you
changed: "Start with Windows" moved out of the installer into the app's SETUP tab — same feature, fewer antivirus false positives
Releases now ship SHA256 checksums so you can verify your download
